messages:
Liam: Morning folks   found a half-used box of assorted scones in the kitchen labeled 'Free?'. Anyone put these out? :bagel:
Harpreet: Not me. But if free, I'll nom a blueberry one. Quick heads-up: we had someone with a gluten allergy last month so maybe mark wheat items clearly.
Dana: I'll take the last cinnamon scone if it's okay. Also FYI the electric kettle is acting flaky  it clicks but doesn't heat sometimes. Could someone check the plug?
Irene: That was me who brought those scones (thanks to a neighbor bakery!). Sorry I wasn't around to label them. I'll add a note: 'Contains wheat, may have nuts' and move the box to the counter so it's obvious.
Liam: Thanks Irene! Also can we tape a small allergen sticker? Maybe use `Nuts?` `Gluten` lines.
Harpreet: Good idea. I'll print 6 tiny stickers and leave them in the drawer by the labels.
Dana: Kettle: unplugged and replugged, appears to work now but it's losing time to heat. Could be the base. If it dies again, maybe replace? :grimacing:
KitchenBot: Reminder: Small appliances maintenance request form -> https://internal/ops/kit-maint. If an appliance is unreliable, please file there so facilities can review. Next community tidy: Friday 9:30am. :robot_face:
Irene: Filed a maintenance request just now (ID #MK-2245). Also taped a laminated note on the scone box with the allergen info and my name.
Liam: Thanks Irene. Dana  mind saving one scone for lunch? I'll snag coffee from the lobby in 15m if someone needs beans we can split.
Dana: Saved one. Also quick vote: for recurring Thursday snack runs do we prefer bakery (pastries) or savory (sandwiches)? React :one: pastries :two: savory
Harpreet: :one: pastries for my soul
Irene: :two: savory sometimes is nice for lunches
Liam: :one: pastries but rotate with savory every 3 weeks
KitchenBot: Action: Irene provided scones (labeled). Maintenance request MK-2245 submitted for kettle. Vote tallies: pastries 2, savory 1.
Harpreet: Also threw $4 in the coffee fund jar. Thinking maybe a small pledge sheet so people can note if they prefer decaf or regular when someone volunteers to buy beans.
Dana: Love that. I'll make a tiny `Coffee Preferences` sticky for the jar: `Name | Regular/Decaf | Milk preference`.
Liam: Perfect. If the kettle stops working tomorrow I'll heat water on the stove and label it `manual kettle` until facilities respond. No one should use it unsupervised.
Irene: Thanks y'all. Scone trade is open  help yourselves but read the label. :cupcake:
